title: Giving birth costs a lot. Hospitals won't tell you how much.
summary: A Vox reporter tries to learn what his son's birth would cost before it happens and fails, showing how opaque US hospital pricing is even for the most common procedure.
why: HN cites it as the go-to example of how impossible it is to get prices in advance for US medical care.

quote.text: Here's a great video that I think is related to this topic about the near-impossibility of finding out the cost of giving birth
